why: The data folder doors' refusals (criteria DF17 to DF21). Each needs this computer's process table, a real data folder move, or a server given no way to start the mover, so no door here can safely meet them: a move here would start a process that stops an office, and a confirm would remove files. tests/the-data-folder-door.test.ts meets each press refusal through the door on a scratch office, whose mover is a process the test starts and stops itself. The stored files' refusal for an unreadable mark is met by tests/a-moved-data-folder-still-shows-its-stored-files.test.ts.
